claims.quote: Betta gladiator is a large paternal mouthbrooding labyrinth fish presumed endemic to the isolated Maliau basin in Sabah, Malaysian Borneo.
Presumed endemic to the geographically-isolated Maliau basin, a roughly circular plateau enclosed by hills in Sabah state, Malaysia, Borneo.
